# JD's Horse Ranch

Official redesigned public information site:
https://jdshorseranch.codewithsolo.com/

JD's Horse Ranch offers guided horseback trail rides, horseback riding lessons and horse-related special occasions in Fairburn, Georgia, near Atlanta.

## Verified public facts
- Address: 7555 Jones Road, Fairburn, GA 30213, USA
- Phone: +1 404-981-2361
- Booking method: telephone conversation with JD; appointment only, no walk-ins
- Riding lessons: 1 hour starting at $85; for children age 9 and under, 30 minutes at $45
- Guided trail rides: 1 rider, 1 hour $85; 2 riders, 1 hour $160; 3 riders, 1 hour $245
- Special occasions: inquire about birthdays, photos and video shoots; published one-hour horse rental $200
- Deposits: non-refundable; rescheduling requires at least 24 hours' notice and JD's approval
- Prices and availability should be confirmed by phone before visiting or paying
